title: Toward Reliable VLM: A Fine-Grained Benchmark and Framework for Exposure, Bias, and Inference in Korean Street Views

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating geolocation accuracy across four distinct socio-spatial city clusters (categorized by population density and Gross Regional Domestic Product) and analyzing confusion matrices to measure the models' tendency to misclassify lower-density, non-core regions as high-density capital cities (centralization bias).
